disease_scope: Adult glioblastoma and closely related adult high-grade diffuse glioma evidence, retained with diagnosis and cohort boundaries rather than silently merged.

policy.candidate_claim: This simulation-generated candidate passed declared retrospective computational qualification and is ready for independent experimental falsification.
policy.prohibited_claim: A simulation result alone is not a treatment, evidence of clinical efficacy, or a cure.

sources.title: Multi-scale signaling and tumor evolution in high-grade gliomas
sources.custodian: National Cancer Institute Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium
sources.version_locator: Publication release dated 2024-07-08; exact GDC and PDC release identifiers and file hashes must be frozen before admission.
sources.disease_scope: High-grade glioma cohort containing 212 glioblastomas and 16 grade-4 IDH-mutant astrocytomas; diagnoses must remain distinguishable.
limitations: The cohort mixes molecularly distinct adult high-grade glioma diagnoses.
Most measurements are destructive endpoint assays rather than repeated observations of the same living tissue.
Open and controlled files have different access obligations.

sources.title: Glioma Longitudinal AnalySiS Consortium Data Resource
sources.version_locator: Public resource release dated 2022-05-31; exact Synapse entity versions must be frozen before admission.
sources.disease_scope: Adult diffuse glioma with multi-timepoint profiles; histologic and molecular diagnoses must remain explicit.
limitations: The resource is heterogeneous because contributing cohorts used different assays and collection practices.
Raw sequencing is not generally available for analysis because multiple jurisdictions govern contributed data.
Longitudinal observations describe realized histories and do not reveal outcomes under treatments not received.

sources.title: Ivy Glioblastoma Atlas Project
sources.custodian: Allen Institute for Brain Science and partners
sources.version_locator: Static public atlas with no scheduled updates; exact public-bucket object inventory and hashes must be frozen before admission.
sources.disease_scope: Anatomically annotated human glioblastoma resections with de-identified specimen metadata.
limitations: Laser-microdissected regions and adjacent sections are samples of a heterogeneous tumor rather than a complete three-dimensional tumor.
The atlas is cross-sectional and cannot identify untreated temporal trajectories.
Additional clinical and genomic data in the partner database require registration.

sources.title: CellMiner DTP ALMANAC Combo Score
sources.custodian: National Cancer Institute Genomics and Pharmacology Facility and Developmental Therapeutics Program
sources.version_locator: CellMiner database 2.15 export dated 2025-09-17; retained ZIP SHA-256 161a0801e5a34c1fd1a3ae5b3c743d0b481d979b1c61fb08c75031b980233a0a.
sources.disease_scope: NCI-60 multi-cancer immortalized cell-line panel; only the explicitly labeled CNS panel is used by the GBM-oriented baseline, without treating it as a patient cohort.
limitations: ComboScore is an in-vitro interaction screen and does not measure patient benefit, toxicity, therapeutic index, or clinical safety.
The normalized matrix summarizes drug-pair activity and does not retain the full concentration-response surface needed to independently recompute every score.
Long-established two-dimensional cell lines omit patient tumor architecture, pharmacokinetics, immune context, and much of the microenvironment.

sources.title: CellMiner Compound Activity: DTP NCI-60 Average Z Score
sources.custodian: National Cancer Institute Genomics and Pharmacology Facility and Developmental Therapeutics Program
sources.version_locator: CellMiner database 2.15 export dated 2025-09-17; retained ZIP SHA-256 17e6a62597a32caa5d43d2e8f81422c108b47bcefd51a3b2269834001da1d7aa.
sources.disease_scope: NCI-60 multi-cancer immortalized cell-line panel; only the explicitly labeled CNS panel is used by the GBM-oriented baseline, without treating it as a patient cohort.
limitations: Activity z scores are normalized pattern values, not administered doses, response probabilities, or clinical effect sizes.
The six CNS lines are not a representative sample of contemporary molecularly defined glioblastoma patients.
Long-established two-dimensional cell lines omit patient tumor architecture, pharmacokinetics, immune context, and much of the microenvironment.

sources.title: NCI Patient-Derived Models Repository
sources.version_locator: Continuously maintained repository; individual model, sequence-pipeline, pathology, and material revisions must be pinned independently.
sources.disease_scope: Multi-cancer patient-derived model repository; only diagnosis-confirmed glioblastoma models are eligible for GBM qualification.
limitations: Repository acquisition routes include rapid autopsy, but that does not mean every available model was derived from autopsy tissue.
Mouse stroma, culture selection, passage, and engraftment can change a patient tumor model.
Physical models require an approved request and material-transfer agreement.

sources.title: A spatially resolved human glioblastoma atlas reveals distinct cellular and molecular patterns of anatomical niches
sources.custodian: Publication authors, NCBI SRA, Zenodo, and UCSC Cell Browser
sources.version_locator: BioProject PRJNA1337938 plus Zenodo records 17622242 and 17572905; exact repository revisions and checksums must be frozen before admission.
sources.disease_scope: Human glioblastoma single-cell, CITE-seq, and spatial transcriptomic tissue atlas.
limitations: Spatial assays cover sampled sections and panels rather than every molecular species in a complete living tumor.
Different spatial platforms have different resolution, capture, and batch characteristics.
Public availability does not waive repository terms, attribution, or patient-protection obligations.

sources.title: The Somatic Genomic Landscape of Glioblastoma
sources.custodian: National Cancer Institute Genomic Data Commons
sources.version_locator: Publication data freeze dated 2012-10-10 plus current GDC release identifiers; exact files and corrections must be frozen before admission.
sources.disease_scope: Retrospective multidimensional characterization of more than 500 glioblastoma tumors.
limitations: The cohort is retrospective and cross-sectional for most participants.
Some raw genomic files and potentially identifying fields require dbGaP authorization.
Molecular association and survival correlation do not identify causal treatment effects.
